summary: The 27th ruler of Silla and the first queen regnant in Korean history. She oversaw the construction of the Cheomseongdae observatory and promoted Buddhism and scholarship during her reign.

Korean independence activist and politician who served as the president of the Provisional Government of the Republic of Korea in Shanghai. He dedicated his life to Korean independence and reunification.
Queen consort of the Joseon dynasty, known for her political influence and diplomatic efforts to counter Japanese encroachment. She was assassinated by Japanese agents in the Eulmi Incident of 1895.

A Korean scientist and inventor during the Joseon dynasty, best known for creating the Jagyeongnu (self-striking water clock), Angbuilgu (sundial), and other scientific instruments under the patronage of King Sejong.
South Korean filmmaker who directed Parasite (2019), the first non-English language film to win the Academy Award for Best Picture. Known for genre-blending storytelling and sharp social commentary.
